# tomswallapi_stopped_rule (Resource)

Traffic permitted when the firewall is stopped, on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_stopped_rule" "admin_ssh" {
  device = "fw1"
  action = "ACCEPT"
  source = "eth1:192.0.2.0/24"
  proto  = "tcp"
  dport  = ["22"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) accept, drop, ...
- `device` (String) Owning device.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `dport` (List of String) Destination ports or port ranges to match.
- `proto` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `source` (String) Source to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `sport` (List of String) Source ports or port ranges to match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_stopped_rule.admin_ssh 42
```
